description: A YouTube video's captions as plain text and timestamped segments, with the video's title, channel, duration, views, publish date, chapters and the list of caption languages. Accepts watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed and live links or the 11-character id; pick a language with lang (default English, else the first track). Auto-generated captions contain recognition errors. A video without captions is a 404 and not charged. Price: $0.01 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

lang.description: Caption language code, e.g. en, de or pt-BR (optional)

url.description: A YouTube link (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed or live), or the 11-character video id

name: youtube_transcript
title: Youtube Transcript
